hooks.command: input=$(cat); cmd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'git (commit|push)'; then echo '{"decision": "block", "reason": "git commit and git push are blocked — run these yourself"}'; exit 0; fi

input=$(cat); file=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); if echo "$file" | grep -qP '\.env$'; then echo '{"decision": "block", "reason": ".env is blocked — edit .env.example instead"}'; fi

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in */postgres/init/*|*/postgres/migrations/*) jq -n --arg m 'Database change: every schema change goes into BOTH postgres/init/ (01-schema.sql, grants for new tables in 05-grant-app-permissions.sql) AND a new idempotent postgres/migrations/NNN_description.sql (IF NOT EXISTS / CREATE OR REPLACE / DO blocks, no BEGIN or COMMIT, GRANT ... TO :app_user, no SELECT of member data). Never edit a migration that has already run. Update the other side now if it is missing. See Schema Changes in CLAUDE.md.' '{hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "PostToolUse", additionalContext: $m}}';; esac
